# Lexbor 3.0.0

Vendored from the official v3.0.0 source archive:
https://github.com/lexbor/lexbor/releases/tag/v3.0.0

Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and NOTICE. Saga compiles the core, DOM, HTML,
encoding, namespace, tag, Punycode and Unicode modules as a static library.
Unused CSS, selectors, style, URL and engine modules are omitted. No download
is required during configuration, compilation or execution.

The upstream source is unmodified. Saga owns the build definition in its
top-level CMakeLists.txt.
